headline: $200,000 from revolving fund approved for first round of Ella Risk Elementary bathroom repairs.
summary: Staff gave updates on the high school closeout, the track and field, and the dual language school. The group also approved the bathroom spending and paid two bills.
decisions: Approved spending up to $200,000 from the revolving fund on the first round of Ella Risk Elementary bathroom repairs, with one no vote.
Approved payment of bond requisition number six and FOI requisition number two.
discussion: Bathroom project scope: Members asked whether district staff or city public works could do parts of the work to lower costs. They also questioned whether there were enough skilled staff for the job.

Air handling unit: A member said a unit serving the admin wing had failed. Staff said three quotes were gathered, and members said a vote could not happen that day and might come up at the December meeting.
High school windows: A member asked why the new high school windows do not open. Staff said the building is sealed and air-conditioned through roof units, and the windows open only about four inches.
Revolving fund balance: Members were told the fund holds about $370,000, and that all past projects have been fully reimbursed.

decision_evidence.quote: on behalf of the group, I would like to request authorization from the SBC to spend up to $200,000 from the revolving fund on the first round of bathroom repairs at Ella Risk Elementary School. ... All in favor? Aye. Aye. Any opposed? Nay. ... Okay. Um, all right. The motion passes.

Uh, I can make a a motion to bundle and approve the School Bond Series 2025 number six for $1,570,900 and $7.86, and the Facilities Opportunity Initiative requisition number two for $276,273.36. ... Okay, hearing none, we are moving forward with the payment of the bills.
